title.narrative: Provision of lifesaving humanitarian assistance and livelihood support in Northwest Region (Sagaing and Magway)

description.narrative: ltpgtThis very project initially targeted 9 townships in Sagaing (Khin-U, Ye-U, Shwebo, Taze, Yinmarbin, Kani, Salingyi, Pale and Kale) and 4 townships in Magway (Saw, Gangaw, Pauk and Pakokku) providing support for ltbgt74.783 unique beneficiarieslt/bgt such as ltbgt6,540 IDPs (2.300 women, 1,025 girls, 2,300 men, 915 boys)lt/bgt and ltbgt68.243 Host populationlt/bgt ltbgt(24,856 women, 10,104 girls, 23,748 men, 9,535 boys)lt/bgt. The project is a consortium and consisted with_ ltbrgtlt/pgtltulgtltligtltbgtSTHlt/bgt for Khin-U, Ye-U, Shwebo and Taze (moved from Tabayin) townships to provide humanitarian assistance under food security, Shelter/NFI, nutrition, protection and WASH Clusters lt/ligtltligtltbgtAYOlt/bgt for Yinmarbin, Kani, Salingyi, Pale to provide humanitarian assistance under WASH Cluster lt/ligtltligtltbgtWJlt/bgt for Kani, Salingyi and Pale to provide humanitarian assistance under food security, Shelter/NFI, nutrition, protection and WASH Clusters lt/ligtltligtltbgtKYDOlt/bgt for Saw, Gangaw, Pauk and Pakokku to provide humanitarian assistance under food security, Shelter/NFI, nutrition, protection and WASH Clusters, and lt/ligtltligtltbgtTLMMlt/bgt as a technical support, capacity building and monitoring for disability inclusion for all 13 townships and specific assistance such as cash assistance, assistive devices and prothesis assistance for PwDs from all townships in Sagaing and Magway Regions under protection cluster. lt/ligtltligtltbgtCDN ZOAlt/bgt, as a consortium lead, ltbgtlt/bgt is responsible for the capacity enhancement of local partners as well as being the contract lead, managing reporting, technical support, fund management as well as the monitoring of projects. lt/ligtlt/ulgtltpgtAt the beginning of July 2024, a list of organization names including STH, came up in the internet news that SAC would investigate those organizations with the suspicion of supporting local resistance forces (People’s Defence Forces-PDF) and ethnic revolutionary organizations (EROs) where they were working. All those organizations took safety measures for the sake of their staff members and implementing partner organizations by suspending and terminating all the on-going activities and projects. Some even dissolved their organizations. In the case of STH, it suspended all of its activities and projects including #26918, and asked the employees to evacuate and stay in safer places as a first-step measures. On 19 July, STH confirmed ZOA that the Board of Directors of STH decided to terminate and finalize all of its projects for the whole 2024. In the project #26918, STH would continue until end of October to finalize the ongoing activities and for MEAL and financial reporting. lt/pgtltpgtIn consultation with MHF, CDN-ZOA and its consortium partners decided to replace STH with a new organization ltbgt“Kyal Sin Tan Development Association (KSTDA)lt/bgt” for ltbgtTigyaing townshiplt/bgt and ltbgtWJ to extend its coverage for Pale townshiplt/bgt, to provide MPC assistance, WASH assistance and protection awareness raising and referral support for the victims of EO.ltbrgtAs of 30 June (mid-term report), the assistance of project has reached to ltbgt10,797 IDP (4,736 women, 1,358 girls, 3,323 men and 1,380 boys) and 4,951 people of host communities (3,053 women, 254 girls, 1,485 men and 159 boys)lt/bgt by STH, AYO, WJ, KYDO and TLMM.ltbrgtAdditionally, the MPC, WASH and protection assistance of ltbgtKSTDA and WJ will reach 11,965 IDP (4727 women, 1621 girls, 4179 men and 1438 boys)lt/bgt in Tigyaing and Pale townships.ltbrgtlt/pgt
